                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 31 ÷ 19 x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\({31 \\over 19}\\) x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 31x 3 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 93 = 93 (বামপক্ষ = ডানপক্ষ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      এবং,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 52 C 13 D 5 = 20
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 52 ÷ 13 x 5= 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 4 x 5 = 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 20 = 20 (বামপক্ষ = ডানপক্ষ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      অনুরূপভাবে,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 98 C 14 D 11 = ?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 98 ÷ 14 x 11 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 7 x 11 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 77 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      অতএব, সঠিক উত্তর হল \"77\"

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n206:T97f,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      અહીં નીચેનો તર્ક લાગુ પડે છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C ને 'અહીં નીચેનો તર્ક લાગુ પડે છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • C ને '÷'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • D ને 'x'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        આપેલ છે,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 31 C 19 D 57 = 93
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 31 ÷ 19 x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\({31 \\over 19}\\) x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 31x 3 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 93 = 93 (લ.સા.અ. = ગુ. સા.અ.)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        અને,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 52 C 13 D 5 = 20
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 52 ÷ 13 x 5= 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 4 x 5 = 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 20 = 20 (લ.સા.અ. = ગુ. સા.અ.)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        તેવી જ રીતે,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 98 C 14 D 11 = ?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 98 ÷ 14 x 11 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 7 x 11 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 77 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        તેથી, સાચો જવાબ \"77\" છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n207:Ta69,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಸರಿಸಲಾದ ತರ್ಕವೆಂದರೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಸರಿಸಲಾದ ತರ್ಕವೆಂದರೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • C ಅನ್ನು '÷' ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • D ಅನ್ನು 'x' ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 31 C 19 D 57 = 93
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 31 ÷ 19 x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\({31 \\over 19}\\) x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 31x 3 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 93 = 93 (ಎಡಬದಿ = ಬಲಬದಿ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಮತ್ತು,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 52 C 13 D 5 = 20
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 52 ÷ 13 x 5= 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 4 x 5 = 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 20 = 20 (ಎಡಬದಿ = ಬಲಬದಿ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 98 C 14 D 11 = ?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 98 ÷ 14 x 11 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 7 x 11 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 77 = ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ \"77\".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n208:T90c,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          இங்கு பயன்படுத்தப்படும் தர்க்கம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • C ஐ '÷", "ta": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            இங்கு பயன்படுத்தப்படும் தர்க்கம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • C ஐ '÷'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • D ஐ 'x'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            கொடுக்கப்பட்டது,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 31 C 19 D 57 = 93
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 31 ÷ 19 x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\({31 \\over 19}\\) x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 31x 3 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 93 = 93 (LHS = RHS)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            மேலும்,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 52 C 13 D 5 = 20
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 52 ÷ 13 x 5= 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 4 x 5 = 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 20 = 20 (LHS = RHS)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            அதேபோல்,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ଏଠାରେ ଅନୁସରଣ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ତର୍କଟି ହେଉଛି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ଦିଆଯାଇଛି,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 31 C 19 D 57 = 93
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 31 ÷ 19 x 57 = 93

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ \\({31 \\over 19}\\) x 57Total students in college = 500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Number of students who play cricket = 350

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Number of students who play kabaddi = 125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Number of students who neither play cricket nor kabaddi = 75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Number of students who either play cricket or kabaddi = (Total students in college - Number of students who neither play cricket nor kabaddi)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 500 - 75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 425

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Number of students who play both cricket and kabaddi = (Number of students who play cricket + Number of students who play kabaddi) - Number of students who either play cricket or kabaddi 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒  350 + 125 - 425

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒  50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Percentage of the number of students who play both cricket and kabaddi = (Number of students who play both cricket and kabaddi / Total students in college) × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ \\({50 \\over 500} \\times 100\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 10%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Therefore, there are 10% of students who neither play both cricket and kabaddi.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Hence, the correct answer is "10".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              क्रिकेट किंवा कबड्डी न खेळणाऱ्या विद्यार्थ्यांची संख्या = ७५
